fit.label: Job 1
fit.title: Principal Backend Engineer
fit.sample_note: Sample job description written for this demo, not a real posting.
fit.description: Sample Co. is hiring a Principal Backend Engineer to own the design and reliability of our core platform. You will design event-driven services in Go and Python on AWS Lambda and make the trade-offs behind them, keep cold starts and concurrency under control, handle failures and retries safely, debug them under load, own them end to end including on-call, lead projects across teams and mentor engineers. Experience with LLM tooling (MCP, RAG, evals) is a plus.

questions.q: What has the candidate owned end to end, including on-call?
Why did the candidate pick Lambda over containers here, and what was the trade-off?
At peak, how did the candidate keep cold starts and concurrency limits in check?
questions.requirement: Lambda at scale: cold starts, concurrency

questions.q: What happens when one poison message lands in a batch, and how do retries avoid applying an update twice?
When p99 latency spikes under load, how does the candidate track down the cause?
Tell me about a time the candidate got several teams to agree on a change.
What kind of team does the candidate want to join next?

role_facts: Yes: the headcount is approved and funded, and we're interviewing this month.
The team reads every screening report within two days.
